title: Yoga Teacher Training Courses in Ubud Bali
metaTitle: Yoga Teacher Training Courses in Ubud Bali
metaDescription: Embark on your yoga teaching journey in Ubud, Bali. Choose from 50–300 hour Yoga Alliance-certified courses. Deepen your practice amid Bali’s spiritual landscape.
intro: Ubud offers a deeply enriching yoga experience as it possesses a wonderful combination of the nature, spirituality, Hindu culture, making it the perfect place to participate in yoga teacher training courses. Bali Yoga School campus is peacefully located just a short 10-minute ride from the center of Ubud, providing a peaceful environment for you to concentrate on your yoga teacher training yet a very easy access to the town’s vibrant heart.

Our curriculum of the yoga teacher training courses in Ubud, Bali mirrors the deep-rooted traditional practices of the Himalayan Yoga Association in Rishikesh, India, all while being enriched by Ubud’s spiritual and vibrant environment which promotes a balanced lifestyle.

Crafted under the guidance of Yogi Himanshu, our yoga teacher trainings in Ubud, Bali include intense daily yoga practices that include many different core practices of yoga, alongside unique experiences such as kirtan nights, partner stretching session, 108 sun salutations session, vegan cooking classes, beach yoga excursion, and participating in Balinese temple rituals.

issues: Card link targets (hrefs) were not captured in the source audit; listedItems[].path values marked pathInferred=true were matched by card wording (hours/level/campus) to existing course URLs in pages-index.csv — verify against the live site.

Duration conflicts (hub vs course pages): 50 h listed as '6 days' — /courses/50-hour-yoga-teacher-training-in-bali/ text mentions '8 days' (and 'Course length ... 8 days (7 nights)'); 100 h listed as '12 days' — /courses/100-hour-yoga-teacher-training-in-bali/ mentions '15 days' and '11 days'; 200 h listed as 'a 24-day course' — /courses/200-hour-yoga-teacher-training-in-bali/ says '25 days'; Yin 50 h '6 days' vs Yin 50 h page '8 days'; Yin 100 h '12 days' vs Yin 100 h page '15 days'; Yin 200 h '24 days' vs Yin 200 h page '25 days'/'20 days'. Home cards (per audit A2) say 100 h = 15 days, 200 h = 25 days.
Meta description says '50–300 hour' courses but the page also lists a 500 hour course.
50 h Yin card says the second half can be completed 'at any campus of Bali Yoga School branches, such as Himalayan Yoga Association' — verify.
Google Maps embed not recorded for this page in video-and-map-embeds.csv; only the heading 'Bali Yoga School Location' is captured.

Unverified marketing claims not used: 'providing authentic Yoga Teacher Training Courses in Ubud, Bali even before this massive yoga teacher training boom', 'We have made the best 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Ubud', 'there is no other yoga course better than this' (500 h), 'the best Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Ubud'.
